The Swiss foreign ministry said on Friday the patient in Nigeria, the Ugandan-born wife of a Swiss diplomat based in Abuja, had not travelled to the Democratic Republic of ⁠Congo, where the outbreak was first detected in mid-May before spreading to Uganda, Kenya and now Nigeria. The woman was believed to have contracted Ebola while travelling with her husband in Uganda, the ministry added.

topArticle.description: Her alleged attacker, 43-year-old Brendan Nugent, faces multiple charges and appeared in court for the first time on Wednesday.
topArticle.titleJa: オーストラリア議員が車による襲撃で両足を失うと夫が語る
topArticle.summary: オーストラリアの女性議員が車による襲撃を受け両足を失ったと夫が証言。容疑者は複数の罪状で出廷しました。

topArticle.title: The Philippines launches safeguard investigation on pork
topArticle.description: On 21 October 2026, the Philippines notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards that it had initiated on 9 October 2026 a safeguard investigation on imports of pork.
topArticle.titleJa: フィリピン、豚肉のセーフガード調査を開始
topArticle.summary: フィリピンは2026年10月9日、豚肉輸入に対するセーフガード調査を開始したことをWTOに通報した。

topArticle.title: Talks kick off for Timor-Leste's accession to government procurement pact
topArticle.description: At a meeting of the Committee on Government Procurement on 14 October, parties to the Government Procurement Agreement (GPA) 2012 welcomed Timor-Leste's submission of key documents required to kick off its negotiations on acceding to the Agreement. The Committee also reviewed regulatory developments, heard updates on the accession process of other members, and for the first time conducted a dialogue with the private sector on the significance of the Agreement in a changing trade environment.
topArticle.titleJa: 東ティモールの政府調達協定加盟交渉が開始
topArticle.summary: 10月14日の政府調達委員会で、東ティモールが協定加盟交渉開始に必要な書類を提出。委員会は規制動向をレビューし、民間部門との対話も行った。

topArticle.title: Madagascar launches safeguard investigation on certain confectionary
topArticle.description: On 12 October 2026, Madagascar notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards that it had initiated on 9 October 2026 a safeguard investigation on imports of sugar confectionary as well as chocolate and cocoa confectionary.
topArticle.titleJa: マダガスカル、特定の菓子類に対するセーフガード調査を開始
topArticle.summary: マダガスカルは2026年10月9日、砂糖菓子およびチョコレート・ココア菓子類の輸入に対するセーフガード調査を開始したことをWTOに通報した。

topArticle.title: WTO-ITC visit to Mogadishu supports Somalia's preparations for next phase of WTO accession
topArticle.description: The WTO and the International Trade Centre (ITC) conducted their first joint technical assistance activity in Mogadishu, Somalia, from 10 to 15 October to support the government's preparations for the second meeting of the Working Party on the accession of Somalia. Supported by the United Kingdom, the technical assistance event also included discussions on regional integration and the forthcoming Trade for Peace Somalia Initiative.
topArticle.titleJa: WTO-ITC、ソマリアのWTO加盟準備を支援するためモガディシュを訪問
topArticle.summary: WTOとITCは10月10-15日、ソマリアのモガディシュを訪問し、ソマリア政府のWTO加盟に向けた技術支援を行った。
